For Business Owners & Founders

You built the business. We help you grow it, transform it, or exit it well.

Investment readiness, value creation, and transformation for owners and founders in maritime, transport, and logistics. Operator-led, and priced for a company your size.

The problem

What you are really up against

You know your business better than any advisor. But when it's time to raise, sell, or professionalize, the big firms are expensive and generic, and they've never actually run a maritime operation. You need someone who has sat in the operator's chair, who can get the business ready for the next step without a six-figure consulting bill and a deck full of theory.

How we help

What you get

Deliverables, not a deck of theory

  • An investment-readiness assessment: what a buyer or investor will probe, and where you're exposed.
  • A value-gap analysis with a prioritized list of improvements before a sale.
  • A transformation roadmap with owners, milestones, and cadence.
  • A clear view of your likely value story and how to strengthen it.
How we work

Our process

A short diagnostic first, then a focused engagement with weekly updates and a clear current-state to future-state plan. Sized to your business, not a template. We work with owners worldwide, and for hands-on operating and interim roles we focus where we can be on the ground.

Track record

What our founding team has done

Our founder has built and professionalized commercial functions from scratch and turned cost centers into profit centers.

Every item below reflects work our team has personally led, as operators, before Navex.

  • Grew EBITDA by more than 130% in 15 months as regional CEO of a global maritime services group, rebuilding a commercial pipeline from near zero to over $30M.
  • As chief commercial officer of a PE-owned marine services company, delivered several consecutive years of 50 to 77% revenue and EBITDA growth, executed six bolt-on acquisitions across three continents, and helped deliver a successful exit.
  • Worked through four private-equity ownership rounds at a global ship management group, including a $1.3bn transaction.
  • Across a 25-year operating career: five exits, more than ten bolt-on acquisitions, and over $1bn in enterprise value shaped.

Figures reflect the founding team's operator experience prior to Navex.
